name: Nuttycombe Wisconsin Invitational
where: Madison, WI · host Wisconsin · Thomas Zimmer Championship Cross Country Course
headline: Nuttycombe: New Mexico wins the men's title
summary: New Mexico won the men's title with 59 points to Colorado's 93, with No. 7 BYU third at 146; Colorado freshman Meshack Kipruto won in a course-record 22:30.1, 0.7 seconds ahead of New Mexico's Pasanjo Kitonga. West Virginia took the women's race with 66 points to Florida's 111 and Northern Arizona's 130, and Florida's Judy Chepkoech won in 19:19.5.

insights.lede: No. 1 New Mexico won by 34 points over No. 6 Colorado, 59–93, while No. 2 Iowa State finished 19th. Colorado freshman Meshack Kipruto won in a course-record 22:30.1, and the top four men all broke the old Zimmer record of 22:33.8.
insights.dual: Score New Mexico one-on-one against every other team and it wins all 34. In 38 pairings the lower-placed team wins the head-to-head. Best example: Florida (5th) tops Arkansas (4th), 28–28, settled on the sixth runner.
insights.next: Remove every senior and re-score: BYU takes it with 119. New Mexico, down 1 scorer, drops to 2nd at 127.
notes: New Mexico sat 2nd at 2K, went to the front at 4K and stayed there. Colorado was the early leader at 2K before settling for 2nd.
Quickest 6K-to-finish: Meshack Kipruto (Colorado), 5:35.0, on the way to the win. Next best: Elsingi Kipruto (Louisville), 5:35.8, on the way to 3rd.

insights.lede: No. 9 West Virginia won with 66 points to No. 13 Florida's 111 and No. 3 Northern Arizona's 130, a result that moved the Mountaineers to No. 3 in the next poll. Florida's Judy Chepkoech won in 19:19.5.
